identity.title: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (Emiko Yoshino short manga)

leadText: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (Japanese: ミュウと の ルカリオ Mew and the -Guiding Hero: Lucario) is a short adaptation of the movie of the same name. It was adapted by Emiko Yoshino and Hidenori Kusaka and published in 小学４年生 Year 4 Students magazine issues June 2005, July 2005, and August 2005. There are also at least two other manga adaptations of the same movie, a long one by Shigekatsu Ihara and another short one by Miho Asada.
